declarations.name: QFA.Energy.envelope_product_integral

theorem envelope_product_integral
    {M ν R : ℝ} {D : ℝ → ℝ}

    (hD : IntervalIntegrable D volume (0 : ℝ) R) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, envelope M ν D t * D t) =
      (M ^ 4 - (envelope M ν D R) ^ 2) / (4 * ν)

declarations.name: QFA.Energy.product_budget_of_envelope_identity
declarations.signature:
theorem product_budget_of_envelope_identity
    {E D F : ℝ → ℝ} {M ν R : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hFD : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => F t * D t) volume (0 : ℝ) R)
    (hEm : AEStronglyMeasurable E (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R)))
    (hDm : AEStronglyMeasurable D (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R)))
    (hDnn : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R), 0 ≤ D t)
    (hEnn : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R), 0 ≤ E t)
    (hEF : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R), E t ≤ F t)
    (hidentity : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, F t * D t) =
      (M ^ 4 - (F R) ^ 2) / (4 * ν)) :
    Integrable (fun t => E t * D t) (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R)) ∧
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, E t * D t) ≤
        (M ^ 4 - (F R) ^ 2) / (4 * ν) ∧
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, E t * D t) ≤ M ^ 4 / (4 * ν)

declarations.name: QFA.Energy.product_budget
declarations.signature:
theorem product_budget
    {E D : ℝ → ℝ} {M ν R : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hD : IntervalIntegrable D volume (0 : ℝ) R)
    (hEm : AEStronglyMeasurable E (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R)))
    (hDnn : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R), 0 ≤ D t)
    (hEnn : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R), 0 ≤ E t)
    (hEF : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R),
      E t ≤ envelope M ν D t) :
    Integrable (fun t => E t * D t) (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R)) ∧
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, E t * D t) ≤
        (M ^ 4 - (envelope M ν D R) ^ 2) / (4 * ν) ∧
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, E t * D t) ≤ M ^ 4 / (4 * ν)

declarations.name: QFA.Endpoints.GoodTime.exists_good_time_of_integral_lt
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_good_time_of_integral_lt

    (hf : Integrable f (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T), Good t)
    (hbudget : (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, f t) < c * T) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t < T ∧ Good t ∧ f t < c

declarations.name: QFA.Endpoints.GoodTime.exists_subcritical_product_good_time
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_subcritical_product_good_time
    {E D : ℝ → ℝ} {Good : ℝ → Prop} {M ν δ : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hcut : M ^ 4 / (16 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 5) < δ)
    (hprod : Integrable (fun t => E t * D t)
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ)))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ), Good t)
    (hbudget : (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, E t * D t) ≤ M ^ 4 / (4 * ν)) :
    ∃ s, 0 < s ∧ s < δ ∧ Good s ∧ E s * D s < 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4

declarations.name: QFA.Endpoints.Composition.exists_subcritical_good_time_of_envelope
declarations.signature:

declarations.name: QFA.Endpoints.Comparison.CRITICAL_ADMISSIBLE_TIMES_TENDSTO_ZERO
declarations.signature:
theorem CRITICAL_ADMISSIBLE_TIMES_TENDSTO_ZERO
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (P : ℝ → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T), P s) :
    ∃ ε : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ n, ε n ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T ∧ P (ε n)) ∧
      Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)

declarations.name: QFA.Endpoints.Comparison.critical_comparison_differential_gronwall
declarations.signature:
theorem critical_comparison_differential_gronwall
    {y d a : ℝ → ℝ} {s T : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ T)
    (hy : ContinuousOn y (Icc s T)) (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc s T))
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo s T, HasDerivAt y (d t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioo s T, d t ≤ a t * y t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc s T, y t ≤ y s * Real.exp (∫ r in s..t, a r)

declarations.name: QFA.Endpoints.Comparison.CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_GRONWALL
declarations.signature:
theorem CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_GRONWALL
    {e a : ℝ → ℝ} {s T δ : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ T)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc s T))
    (ha_nonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc s T, 0 ≤ a t)
    (hprod : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => a r * e r) volume s T)
    (hrelative : ∀ t ∈ Icc s T,
      e t ≤ δ + ∫ r in s..t, a r * e r) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc s T, e t ≤ δ * Real.exp (∫ r in s..t, a r)

declarations.name: QFA.Endpoints.Comparison.CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_ZERO_OF_ADMISSIBLE_TRACE
declarations.signature:
theorem CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_ZERO_OF_ADMISSIBLE_TRACE
    {e a : ℝ → ℝ} {T M : ℝ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T)
    (he_nonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ e t)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Ioc 0 T))
    (ha_nonneg : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, 0 ≤ a t)
    (ha_integrable : IntervalIntegrable a volume 0 T)
    (hprod : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => a r * e r) volume 0 T)
    (hbudget : (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, a r) ≤ M)
    (hε : ∀ n, ε n ∈ Ioc 0 T)
    (hε_zero : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0))
    (htrace : Tendsto (fun n => e (ε n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hrelative : ∀ n t, t ∈ Icc (ε n) T →
      e t ≤ e (ε n) + ∫ r in ε n..t, a r * e r) :
    ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, e t = 0

declarations.name: QFA.Endpoints.Comparison.CRITICAL_COMPARISON_EQ_OF_ADMISSIBLE_TRACE
declarations.signature:
theorem CRITICAL_COMPARISON_EQ_OF_ADMISSIBLE_TRACE
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    {u v : ℝ → V} {a : ℝ → ℝ} {a₀ : V} {T M : ℝ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Ioc 0 T))
    (ha_nonneg : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, 0 ≤ a t)
    (ha_integrable : IntervalIntegrable a volume 0 T)
    (hprod : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => a r * ‖u r - v r‖ ^ 2) volume 0 T)
    (hbudget : (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, a r) ≤ M)
    (hε : ∀ n, ε n ∈ Ioc 0 T)
    (hε_zero : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hu_trace : Tendsto (fun n => u (ε n)) atTop (𝓝 a₀))
    (hv_trace : Tendsto (fun n => v (ε n)) atTop (𝓝 a₀))
    (hrelative : ∀ n t, t ∈ Icc (ε n) T →
      ‖u t - v t‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖u (ε n) - v (ε n)‖ ^ 2 +
        ∫ r in ε n..t, a r * ‖u r - v r‖ ^ 2) :
    ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, u t = v t
